title: Cookie with Marshmallow, Rice Cereal and Chocolate Chips

content.title: About
content.content: The cookie combines soft marshmallow, crunchy rice cereal and sweet chocolate chips. It is designed for sweet‑tooth lovers who want a variety of flavors and textures in one treat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Marshmallows originated in ancient Egypt as a medicinal confection.
Rice cereal adds lightness and crunch to baked goods.
Chocolate chips are a staple in classic American chocolate chip cookies.
The marshmallow‑rice combination is popular in many Asian desserts.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Carbohydrates from rice cereal and the sugar in marshmallow provide a quick source of energy.

items.title: Antioxidant content
items.content: Chocolate chips are rich in flavonoids, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Mood improvement
items.content: The sweet taste and chocolate aroma stimulate serotonin production, enhancing mood.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The cookie typically contains wheat flour, which can trigger reactions in people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Marshmallow and chocolate chips make the product sweet, so individuals with diabetes should limit consumption.

items.title: Risk of over‑eating
items.content: Crunchy cereal and sweet ingredients can lead to rapid over‑consumption.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookie as a standalone snack, crumble it into milkshakes, use it in dessert salads, or sprinkle it as a topping for ice cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, keep refrigerated to maintain cereal crunch and prevent chocolate melting.
